hero.subtitle: Laboratory-like level of accuracy. Safely at home.

firstParagraph.title: We will never ask you to send samples
firstParagraph.text: Waiting for days to know your results is frustrating at best and plain dangerous at worst. Lab-Away is taking that burden away from you. You can take the tests and see the results at home. No sending back of samples.

secondParagraph.title: Discrete testing with reliable results in a few minutes
secondParagraph.text: Our home test kits provide results with exceptional level of accuracy. Lab-Away delivers lab-quality results at home and most importantly: your results remain at home. Your health status and your data are under your control.

sections.title: Order your Home Test Kit
sections.text: All Lab Away Tests Kits are EU certified and offer absolute reliability, accuracy, and privacy.

sections.title: Take your tests
sections.text: Once you receive your test kit, make sure to carefully read the instructions and follow all steps.

sections.title: Accurate and fast test results
sections.text: Test results appear within 15-25 minutes. We are proud to say that our Lab Away Test Kits offer +99.9% accuracy.

sections.title: All while being at home
sections.text: We’ll never ask you to send a test sample to us. All of our tests are designed to bring results – away from the lab – back to your home. Because your health is your private matter.

about.text: Lab Away is a EU licensed and certified retailer of medically related home test kits. Our tests combine exceptional accuracy and reliability with an unprecedented level of privacy and safety. No sending back of samples. We deeply believe that access to affordable and reliable testing will greatly help people correctly assess their health status and nudge them into seeking help as early as possible.

sections.areaText: We currently ship exclusively within Europe. Orders from outside Europe cannot be processed.

sections.combinedText: If you have ordered items with different delivery times, we will send the goods in one shipment unless a different arrangement has been made. In this case, the delivery time is determined by the item with the longest delivery time in your order.
sections.contactText: If you have any questions, feel free to contact us.

section12.title: Data Retention

Legal retention periods are observed where applicable.
Upon withdrawal of consent, non-essential data will be deleted.

section13.title: Changes to the Privacy Policy
